Enter Obby Civilization, a fast-paced Roblox game where you and your friends can master the art of parkour! Explore an epic world filled with tricky obstacles, ancient structures, and towering buildings.

Team up or compete as you chain parkour combos like jumps, 360s, and backward jumps to boost your score. The flashier the moves, the better! Race through massive courses, leap over ruins, and scale heights while unlocking cool new gear to enhance your parkour.

Features:

😎 Play with friends in co-op or competitive modes.
✨Perform parkour combos to increase your score.
🌟Explore various zones, from a Parkour noob to a Parkour Pro!

Controls:
Left-Shift: Go third-person

Jump in and show off your parkour skills now!
